newsitem.title: USA: Comstock Texas well tests gas, condensate.
newsitem.headline: Comstock Texas well tests gas, condensate.

text.p: Comstock Resources Inc said that its West Bay Carter 1 well had tested at 7,285,000 cubic feet per day of natural gas and 240 barrels of condensate per day on a 16/64 inch choke with flowing tubing pressure of 6,350 pounds per square inch.
The Polk County, Texas well was drilled to 14,530 feet and completed in the Upper Woodbine formation through perforations at 13,981 feet to 14,024 feet, the company said.
Comstock owns a 43 percent in the well and is the operator.
Comstock said its Carter E-12, a 14,400 foot development well on the North edge of the Double A Wells field, is currently drilling at 10,064 feet.
